definition.value: C9orf72+ bvFTD versus healthy controls for salience, sensorimotor, and default mode network connectivity

value: C9orf72+ bvFTD showed similar salience network and sensorimotor network connectivity reductions compared with healthy controls, but no default mode network connectivity differences.
The findings suggest that C9orf72+ bvFTD shows network dysfunction despite contrasting or mild structural atrophy patterns.

name.value: C9orf72- versus HC2 intrinsic connectivity network analysis

definition.value: C9orf72- bvFTD versus healthy controls for salience, sensorimotor, and default mode network connectivity

value: C9orf72- bvFTD showed reduced salience network and sensorimotor network connectivity and both enhanced and reduced default mode network connectivity compared with healthy controls.
Patients without C9orf72 expansions exhibited increases in default mode network connectivity compared to controls and mutation carriers.

name.value: Behavioural symptom severity and salience network connectivity

definition.value: NPI composite score correlated with salience network connectivity

spans.text: Top panel, left: For the salience network, weaker connectivity between the right frontoinsula seed and the left frontoinsula (blue) predicted greater behavioural symptom severity.

value: Patients with more severe behavioural impairment showed lower connectivity between the right frontoinsular cortex seed and the left frontoinsula.
Greater salience network impairment correlated with more severe behavioural symptoms in both C9orf72+ and C9orf72- bvFTD.

name.value: Medial pulvinar connectivity in C9orf72+ versus C9orf72- bvFTD

definition.value: C9orf72+ versus C9orf72- bvFTD connectivity from the left medial pulvinar thalamus

value: C9orf72+ bvFTD showed significantly lower connectivity between the left medial pulvinar and key salience network foci, including the left ventral anterior insula and right anterior midcingulate cortex, compared with C9orf72- bvFTD.
These findings suggest a key role for medial pulvinar thalamus in mediating salience network disruption in C9orf72+ bvFTD.
